title: Length of the trajectory prefix
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $T$ be a natural number. For every natural number $t\le T+1$, the serialized trajectory prefix consisting of the first $t$ rows has length at most $t$ times the number of movement-count fields times $2T+2$; the number of fields is twice the number of heads, including the input head.
replaced: For every source machine, virtual input $y$, horizon $T$, and count $t \le T + 1$, the serialized trajectory prefix of the first $t$ rows has length at most $t$ times the field count times $2T + 2$: every stored count has width at most the horizon and every field is exactly a doubled payload plus its separator.
